effects.rationale: Financial incentives can expand the production of biofuel crops, potentially benefiting farmers and promoting renewable energy.
Biofuel crop production may lead to land use changes that weaken environmental protection through habitat destruction or increased water usage.

evidence_quote: "I believe biofuels can be a part of our energy mix, but we need to ensure their development does not come at the expense of other important environmental goals." - [Source: Candidate's statement on biofuel production in 2010]"
review_reason: The policy may have conflicting effects depending on how it is implemented and balanced with other priorities.
